Anhui Xinyuan Capsule Co., Ltd..evidence: There is no record of an empty capsule manufacturer by this name in China; similar names like Anhui Xinyuan Chemical/Technology Co., Ltd. manufacture epoxy resins and chemical diluents instead.

CapsCanada.evidence: CapsCanada is a real manufacturer of empty hard gelatin and vegetable capsules that officially rebranded as Lyfe Group in 2026. This fact is verified by Lyfe Group's official company history and corporate press releases.
